status: Read-only feasibility proposal; no logging implementation, synthetic run, guest action, memory read or build performed.
conclusion: Feasible bounded observation of GPR snapshots at verified TB-entry PCs with cpu,nochain,guest_errors and a fixed startup address filter. Does not guarantee entry/return pairing or every invocation, and changes scheduling.

observation_limits: dfilter checks TB starting virtual PC, not arbitrary instruction execution. Function-entry call targets and BL continuation are candidate TB boundaries; synthetic and actual PC output must validate.

cpu logs all GPRs/PC/SP/PSTATE as one locked block; no FPU/VPU/assembly. No CPU index or host timestamp in block. Do not pair entries/returns across threads or infer one invocation. Individual exact continuation PC w0 is independently observed return value only if original register liveness matches.

Without nochain, directly chained TBs bypass cpu_tb_exec logging and can be missed. nochain changes curr_cflags CF_NO_GOTO_TB globally, not only inside filter; changes scheduling/translation/cache behavior. No performance or unperturbed reproduction claim.

Changing HMP mask does not synchronously kick/flush executing TB chains; transition occurs on next dispatcher path. Deadline is runner poll bound with QMP delays, not hard real-time. Record actual transition commands and observed last CPU block; finite in-flight output can follow restore.

HMP log replaces whole mask; require known baseline guest_errors and existing-D logfile. Restore literal guest_errors on deadline and every cleanup path, including uncertain enable. CONFIG_TRACE_LOG preserves LOG_TRACE automatically; trace event states remain independently controlled.

Keep existing guest-errors.log inode/path; never logfile command or tid. Separate bounded journal records log offsets, timestamps, command/reply/error and restore state. Interleaved trace/guest-error lines remain raw. HMP empty return alone may not convey stderr log errors, so validate actual file behavior in owned loop and retain stderr.

minimal_future_interface.startup: Explicit opt-in fixed kernel filter flag; default absent. Record actual fixed -dfilter in argv and source/range/slide gate. CPU remains off initially under guest_errors baseline.
minimal_future_interface.mailbox: One exact fixed operation with only bounded integer seconds (proposed1..3), reject if not opted-in, baseline not pinned, active/cleanup pending, or unknown keys. No addresses/log masks from requests. Sole existing QMP owner issues literal HMP log cpu,nochain,guest_errors then literal log guest_errors.
minimal_future_interface.cleanup: Mandatory uncertain-enable restore in finally before QMP quit; monotonic deadline plus small log-byte safety cutoff (e.g.8MiB checked by same poll), journal limits may overshoot during blockingQMP. No replay/autorestart.
minimal_future_interface.phase: Root requests only after independently confirmed visual freeze, with post-window frame comparison. No automatic input.

owned_firmware_free_validation_plan: Actual current binary advertises virt/virt-10.1 (read-only -machine help checked). No existing tracked baremetal loop fixture found by filename search.
